method.compile: one build of each phase/fixture, reused for both rounds; package generator metadata remains 0.6.0 in the paired artifacts
method.command: node --expose-gc benchmark/measure.mjs --group <records|batch> --records <phase-records/module.wasm file URI> [--batch <phase-batch/module.wasm file URI>] --iterations <count> --warmup <count> --runs <count>
method.timing: one process per phase/group, sequential phases; loop, validation, copies and O(1) result consumption included; no concurrent heavy work
method.scope: batch Array snapshots add work absent from single-record loops; JS controls cover valid current-realm inputs, not the full value/error contract; caches/JIT/GC uncontrolled; spreads are not confidence intervals
method.cold_import: not measured by this paired run; focused CLI groups retain fresh-process import and answer() smoke observations; default all uses add(1.5, 2.5) for the api fixture
method.interpretation: modest batch improvement in this environment; no stable direct-record speedup; per-record/index contexts, descriptors and ownership allocations remain
